question_text: Which describes the probability of the spinner landing on {targetColor}?

parts.content: Which describes the probability of the spinner landing on **{targetColor}**?

solution.content: Look at the spinner to see how much of it is **{targetColor}**.
- If the whole spinner is {targetColor}, it is **certain**.
- If more than half is {targetColor}, it is **likely**.
- If less than half is {targetColor}, it is **unlikely**.
- If none of the spinner is {targetColor}, it is **impossible**.
On this spinner, **{targetWeight}** out of **{totalWeight}** parts are {targetColor}. This is **{correct_answer}**.
